item1.name: SGM — Modular General System
item1.description: Internal system for FIDC operational management. Automation of financial routines and portfolio control, resulting in a drastic reduction in manual tasks and centralization of the entire operation.

item2.name: Reversa CRM
item2.description: Custom CRM for collection and relationship management. Automates credit recovery processes and centralizes customer tracking, eliminating spreadsheets and increasing team productivity.

item3.name: Automatic Management Reports
item3.description: Data intelligence platform with automatic updates via Python. Replaces manual generation of complex reports with real-time dashboards with secure and controlled access.

item4.name: Chatbot & WhatsApp API
item4.description: Custom solution for WhatsApp automation without the need for an official API. Allows mass messaging, creation of automated flows, and integration with internal systems for service, billing, and notifications.

item5.name: Nahora — Online Scheduling
item5.description: Online scheduling system with schedule, service, and customer management. Includes automatic confirmations and reminders, plus an administrative panel for complete operational control. Reduces no-shows and organizes the service flow.

item6.name: Zapt — Distribution Management
item6.description: Internal system for distributors to control orders, inventory, and goods deliveries. Centralizes the operation, organizes processes, and reduces errors in the operational flow.

item7.name: Presença Certa — Attendance Management
item7.description: School attendance control system that simplifies teachers' daily routine. Attendance tracking, class management, and automatic reports in a single panel, eliminating spreadsheets and reducing time spent on administrative tasks.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Technology applied to real business processes
about.intro: CODRATEC is a software house focused on custom systems, automations, and digital products that put critical operations into production — with fewer spreadsheets, less rework, and more control for decision-makers.
about.mission: Deliver software that works in day-to-day operations: stable, integrated with company workflows, and evolvable as the business grows. We prioritize clarity, delivery, and measurable impact.

values.title: Operations-first
values.description: We focus on routines that run every day — finance, collections, logistics, support — where mistakes are costly.

values.title: Thoughtful automation
values.description: We automate repetition so people can decide, not fix poorly designed systems.

values.title: Transparent delivery
values.description: Direct communication, aligned scope, and visibility into what is in development and in production.

values.title: Zero to production
values.description: Architecture, development, integrations, and post-launch support from a single technical partner.

approach.title: Understand the process
approach.description: We map how work is done today, where bottlenecks are, and what needs to be measured.

approach.title: Design the solution
approach.description: We define scope, integrations, and priorities clearly before writing code.

approach.title: Build and integrate
approach.description: Iterative development, testing with the client team, and connection to ERPs, APIs, and existing tools.

approach.title: Ship to production
approach.description: Deploy, training, and fine-tuning until the system runs reliably every day.
